notes.title: Prepare for weekend beta playtest!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42842678/4172abb84946ad2c45d7524e0171dc3c5934c703.jpg[/img]

The wait is (almost) over! 🔥[b] Divine Duel BETA is happening THIS weekend![/b] 🔥 

[b]Important info:[/b]
Beta runs from OCT 21 to OCT 24 (starting hours for specific timezones are below)
UK: 9 am BST
Europe: 10 am CEST
US West: 1 am PT
US East: 4 am ET
[list]
[*] Every weapon, item, and booster in the game will be unlocked for your convenience. In the release version, they will be locked behind a progression system to smoothen out the learning curve. Not during the Beta, though. You're in for the deep end
[*] Feel free to record and share whatever you experience. There are no NDAs, embargoes, or anything of this sort
[*] All the participants will receive instructions on Friday - be sure to check your emails! Also, we count on your honest feedback. Join [url=https://discord.gg/xgWMhBDK4e]our Discord server[/url]
[/list]
We've also cooked a brand-new gameplay trailer to get you prepared for what's to come!

[previewyoutube=x_RVn8fb2yA;full][/previewyoutube]

Remember: you can still join the beta. Simply go to the Divine Duel steam page, find the Playtest box and click the "Request access" button. You will be notified via email once the playtests begin!

The Beta build will not work correctly on either Valve Index or HTC Vive. While we developed Divine Duel with these devices in mind, our build is not yet fully compatible with them and is not ready for testing. You can still play the beta in PCVR by using Rift or Quest 1/2 headsets. Sorry for the inconvenience!

[b]⚔️ Stay glorious! ⚔️[/b]

notes.title: Sign up for beta and grab the bow!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello![/h1]

Divine Duel is moving forward with the first Beta. The testing phase is scheduled for late October and all the participants will receive a special item - an exclusive bow!

This weapon will be unlocked in the full version of the game - beta is the only way to get it so make sure that you participate!

[b]Watch the weapon showcase below:[/b]
[previewyoutube=z6NA2Ap522I;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]How to join the beta?[/b]
All you need to do is to click the "Request access" button visible on the Steam game page. You will get a notification once the beta kicks off.

All the feedback and suggestions are welcome and the best place for it would be [url=https://discord.gg/xgWMhBDK4e]our Discord server[/url]. Let's create an ultimate VR fighting game together!

[b]⚔️ Stay glorious! ⚔️[/b]
